display_name: LoRa R17 与实增益主干源域联合微调
description: 冻结 R02/R07/R17 和 E104，联合微调实增益主干及 R17 物理残差双方向头，源域无泄漏筛查。
authorization: 当前聊天 01a2204f-647a-7903-ba29-81cfe8f8749b 的融合研发目标及 N607 有显存即启动要求。

code.environment: N607 CVS-RFFI PyTorch CUDA FP32 TF32off, independent CPU scorer

data.representation: 8192 complex points in 8 x 1024 chirps; frozen W24 E104/default head
data.physical_ids_ref: V RX b200_1: seed 2026112875 choose 300 physical IDs excluding both prior screens (60+300 IDs)
data.label_map_ref: TX31-40 mapped 0-9; L_s labels only in training, U_s true TX hidden; source V truth only in independent scorer
target_receivers: 15 registered held-out LoRa RX remain unopened by this run
data.validation_ref: Existing VALIDATED_ONCE source contract and physical ID ordering
data.leo_config_ref: Registered source Full clean and practical_low_urban views

permissions.claim_scope: LoRa L_s true CE and frozen E104 clean U_s pseudo CE >=0.95 explicitly allowed by same-contract native E104 predecessor. U_s true TX hidden; V and target excluded from updates. V truth read separately only after clean and low-urban predictions freeze.

checkpoint.initialization: Same-contract phase-aware realgain core initialized from its lawful source-only selected checkpoint and trainable; tracker, R02/R07/R17 and E104 frozen; new fusion head zero initialized. Prior rejected fusion is used only for exclusion IDs, not initialization.

sources.role: frozen same-contract LoRa realgain prior; inherited E104 supervised and U pseudo-label history
same-contract R02/R07 context and R17 three-prior unrolled reference
frozen E104 source teacher and original default head, source-V selected E104

checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Prior frozen checkpoints and same lora_rx5_main_v1:392005 role/receiver/ten-class identities; strict loads
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: No cross-dataset checkpoint. LoRa source-only pretarget fixed weights; historic target results have been exposed and source V used by E104 selection.
checkpoint.selection_rule: Final 2000-step checkpoint; low urban same-packet net >=2 in each deterministic half of 300 against direct, native LoRa R17, real gain; clean net >=-2 against each; 2000 paired bootstrap 95% interval. All previous screen IDs excluded.

execution.gpu_policy: One worker; first GPU with >=8192 MiB free in order 5,7,2,3,6,1,4,0; concurrent WiSig worker preserved.
execution.stop_rule: Stop on illegal data or checkpoint, output collision, nonfinite update, missing nonzero finite initial core or dual-gain gradients, incomplete predictions or independent scorer failure; preserve output and other owners.

dimensions: 300 fresh source V physical IDs excluding prior 60+300

rows.method: Trainable phase-aware packet realgain core plus two per-frequency gains applied to R07 adjoint residual and frozen R17 difference; frozen E104 supervision.
rows.seed_notes: Selection seed +2 chooses RX-specific V IDs without labels; +3 assigns screen halves. No support.
rows.optimizer: AdamW weight_decay 1e-4, core LR 1e-5, gain LR 1e-4, cosine to 1e-6, clip 1
rows.budget_ref: 2000 updates, each 4 L_s + 4 U_s; 8000 exposures per role; source-only inherited cost reported separately

notes: Excludes 60+300 earlier screening IDs; E104 historically source-V selected, target benchmark previously exposed.
WiSig same-contract weight inheritance is prohibited; this run uses LoRa-only parents.
Fixed DURA v1 LoRa matching control and full seven-view target test remain outstanding.
Parameter size is reported, not optimized; no compression.
Stop on screen rejection; no formal evaluation or success claim without paired promotion and all controls.
